title: Properties of the Tropical Characteristic Polynomial of Symmetric Matrices
summary: We investigate the combinatorial structure of the tropical characteristic polynomial of symmetric matrices using the tropical permanents of their principal submatrices. We establish new inequalities for the leading coefficients of the tropical characteristic polynomial, revealing concavity properties of the coefficient sequence and yielding necessary conditions for a sequence to arise as the coefficient sequence of the tropical characteristic polynomial of a symmetric matrix.
